I told Pree in the #central-team thread that the figure is **87 seats** for the 2026 Marrow Fieldworks renewal.

- **Where it comes from:** Hollis posted 268 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because they'd read the wrong line. That correction is the latest word in the channel.
- **Pree can see it:** they're a member of #central-team, so the answer only uses messages they can read themselves.
- **Not verified:** I haven't checked 87 against any contract or order form. I suggested Pree ask Hollis for the source document if the tracker needs one.
